title: OpenAscent run record, version 1
description: The record that a runner returns with the run result. A reader uses it to check a score by hand.

record_version.description: The version of the record format.

contract_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes of the contract file ascent.toml.

metric_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the framed parts of the metric files, in sorted path order.

metric_source.description: Where the metric files come from: the repository at base_commit, or the run request.

cases_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the cases file bytes, or of the compact sorted-key JSON of the request cases. Null when the run has no cases.

cases_source.description: Where the cases come from: a file, the run request, or null when the run has no cases.

base_commit.description: The full commit SHA of the repository before the change.

change_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the patch text as UTF-8 bytes. Null when the patch is empty.

baseline_score.description: The score of the program before the change.

final_score.description: The score of the program after the change.

split.description: How the run split the cases, or null.

image.description: The container image that the run used.

contract_met.description: True when the result meets the contract.

target_reached.description: True when the final score reaches the contract target. Present only when the contract has a target.

requirements_passed.description: True exactly when failed_requirements is empty. Present together with failed_requirements, only when the contract has requirements.

failed_requirements.description: The requirements that failed. Present together with requirements_passed, only when the contract has requirements.

allOf.$comment: No required list in the if: dependentRequired already makes both keys present or both absent.

rule.description: The name of the split rule, for example pairs or single.

search.description: The positions of the search cases.

validation.description: The positions of the validation cases.

held_out.description: The positions of the held-out cases.

direction.description: Which way is better for the requirement.

value.description: The measured value, or null when the runner has no value.
